component.name: SP-404MKII Streamer
component.summary: Stream live stereo audio from Roland SP-404MKII to Discord and OBS on Linux

description.p: SP-404MKII Streamer is a lightweight, zero-configuration PipeWire audio bridge for the Roland SP-404MKII sampler on Linux desktop environments.

It captures class-compliant USB audio from the hardware sampler and presents a live stereo playback stream that can be shared in Discord, Vesktop, or OBS without routing matrix complexity, mono compression, or noise suppression interference.
